s0302.literal: [mo] does not contend—changed according to Literary Gathering in the Garden 474.
s0302.idiomatic: On "[end] does not contend": emended per Literary Gathering in the Garden 474.

s0303.literal: Comment: this follows the above "using the end to save the root, losing the root while serving the end"; writing "end" is correct.
s0303.idiomatic: This follows the passage above on using the end to save the root while losing the root to serve the end; end is the correct reading.

s0304.literal: Ordered the eunuch Li Shanqing to investigate the matter exhaustively—"Li Shanqing" in the Southern History reads "Li Shandu."
s0304.idiomatic: On "ordered the eunuch Li Shanqing to investigate the matter exhaustively": the Southern History reads Li Shandu for Li Shanqing.
